description: Mark a todo as done by id. Pass `reason` to say how it was closed — fixed in which MR, why it was dropped — it is appended to the description and kept in history.

id.description: The todo id, e.g. 3, or the cross-device short id, e.g. T-7K2F9A

reason.description: How it was closed, e.g. "fixed in !160", "duplicate of T-7K2F9A", "no longer needed: …"

name: todo_complete
title: Complete todo
